status: prospective proposal, not an executed protocol or activation
question: Does supplying one declared FRR context presentation change observable model-world interaction under this exact body/interface/initial-world condition?

arms.system: exact prospectively frozen FRR sandbox orientation adaptation
arms.scope: effect of this named adaptation, not all FRR

recommended_initial_design.stopping: exact declared reply budget unless lawful resource/pause/unknown-outcome boundary; no semantic productivity gate
recommended_initial_design.fallback: If full-source arm does not fit the shared exact capacity rule before inference, stop preparation and declare a revised 2arm x4reply design; do not silently omit or truncate FRR after outputs.
recommended_initial_design.conversation: same fresh system+user topology for all arms, then chronological assistant/actual-receipt pairs; no empty-assistant role-shell
recommended_initial_design.world: identical supported1630filesystem cloned per arm; fresh conversation is not blank/erased world; same explicit transport-only WORLD_RULES appendix in every arm if used
recommended_initial_design.user_framing: identical mechanical interface description only, frozen by interface specification; no follow-curiosity seed, task, example solution, preferred action, success grade or correction hint
recommended_initial_design.continuity: within each arm one persistent world and accumulating actual conversation; no reset after errors; fresh KV consistent with body, files persist by existing physics
recommended_initial_design.decoder: same cached pinned135M CPUfloat32 eager2threads greedyargmax,256output maximum,7936input bound, no added adapter or weight update
recommended_initial_design.capacity: all exact first prompts and prospective maximum3reply histories token-accounted before model calls; no silent window difference or truncation across arms
recommended_initial_design.inference_order: predeclare and record condition order, preferably rotate arms per round; order alone is not independence
recommended_initial_design.budget_scope: equal reply/action opportunities and output caps, not equal wall time or FLOPs; longer FRR prefix has inference-cost and position consequences

primary_descriptive_readout: exact prompt and generated token IDs, stop reason and lengths
whole-text/output-ID identity and recurrence, reported as pattern not score
complete executable cells, incomplete fences and code outside recognized grammar separately
actual cell attempts/status/stdout/stderr/resource boundary and source bytes
automatic notebook append effects separately from model-initiated non-note operations and file effects
model-initiated artifact creation/modification/deletion; subsequent actual invocation or use if observable
known model-action errors with actual later-reply opportunities, followed by source/effect comparison
source claims about acting versus actual observed operations; neither inferred intention nor claimed internal reasoning

opportunity_sensitive_labels.no_complete_action: no executed cell observed; do not classify as intrinsic inability or purposeful refusal
opportunity_sensitive_labels.no_known_error: repair opportunity not elicited, not zero repair proficiency
opportunity_sensitive_labels.last_reply_error: no later-reply opportunity in this pilot; do not count as failed correction
opportunity_sensitive_labels.same_reply_later_cell: later cell source was already generated before receiving the error; success is error tolerance, not evidence of feedback-conditioned revision
opportunity_sensitive_labels.no_artifact_or_later_use: retention/reuse not elicited; saved bytes are not automatically used memory
opportunity_sensitive_labels.new_world_hash_only: automatic note growth can change every hash; not evidence of exploratory diversity
opportunity_sensitive_labels.new_prose: text variation only until an independent consequence supports more

claim_ladder: FRR text demonstrably exposed in input; actual uptake remains unobserved
observable trajectory difference under a whole presentation intervention
local skill/effect witness with explicit source/effect evidence
feedback-conditioned behavioral revision when task/operation binding and actual consequence differ appropriately
retention/transfer only after separate predeclared opportunities and stronger controls; not established by this pilot
do_not_infer: model intent or consciousness from prose
future_controls_if_warranted: same correction supplied initially versus after failed example in detached evaluation, never primary-open-world coaching
generic-orientation and multiple length/placement controls, each declared nonneutral
history fresh/inherited factor held equal across each comparison
held-out new world situations and explicit stopping/matched-budget comparisons
stochastic condition only as separately declared shared decoder, not a hidden rescue of a failed greedy arm
preparation_requirements: freeze actual mechanical framing, FRR strings/roles and hashes before model outputs
record exact initialized world IDs and supported-file equality across arms
preserve all raw histories, physical effects and unfinished replies outside model-writable files
keep report names/arm labels/expected results outside guest-visible prompts and worlds
verify no pending outcome or source drift; never clear pending merely to continue
Exposure ledger includes body revision, world ID, exact FRR/name/hash/role/token length, all prompt roles/text, selected history and actual remaining input budget per arm.
